short: ReFIT-KF + HMM click (M06) and peak ccpm/bitrate protocol (M12) are standard; 1.4-4.2x record gains mix decoder, task and participants; later decoders reach 90-110 characters/min.
position: The paper [@pandarinath2017high] changes the decoder (M06), a ReFIT Kalman cursor paired with an HMM click, and the evaluation (M12), peak copy-typing ccpm plus achieved grid bitrate without word completion. Both are standard: the paper adapts the ReFIT Kalman filter and HMM click from earlier work, the same pairing ran in monkey typing [@nuyujukian2017nonhuman], and human point-and-click typing used a Kalman cursor with an LDA click [@jarosiewicz2016retrospectively]. The record claim holds as performance, not as evidence for a component: each 1.4-4.2x gain compares across studies, tasks, layouts and partly the same participants (Table 1), and no experiment isolates the HMM click from dwell selection. Later decoders of attempted handwriting and typing reach 90 and 110 characters per minute [@willett2021high; @jude2026bimanual].
